name: Suffuse leaves a single buff and Speed Demon still adds 20% movement speed (#11578)
contract: #11578: Suffuse showed two buffs, one with the description and one with only icon and title. Client DBC: Suffuse 801063 has a single effect, TRIGGER_SPELL 64 into 801064, and no aura effect; 801064 carries the heal-over-time (aura 8), the damage-taken reduction (aura 87) and a native speed aura (aura 31, amount 0). The extra buff was 801063 itself, made an aura by a server contract only to carry Speed Demon's speed. Speed Demon 707232 is the native aura 107 SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (MiscValue 23, BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1) on class mask word1 32768, shared only by 801063 and 801064, so it raises 801064's own speed effect by 20. Expected after Suffuse: aura 801064 present and aura 801063 absent, run speed unchanged without Speed Demon, and with Speed Demon run speed 1.20 times the baseline while aura 801063 stays absent.
